plot-title: The NTA gradient of the net valence under the F4 and the F9 prompt, in SD units of each outcome
plot-caption: As the raw figure, but each net valence is z-scored within (model, case) over the images that enter, thus each axis gives the change of the outcome in its own SDs per 1 SD of the feature. This removes the wider spread of the F9 net valence (about 3 times the F4 SD in the restaurant case). A marker farther from 0 than the dashed line y = x, on the same side, is a steeper gradient under F9. A filled marker has a significant slope of d = z(F9) minus z(F4) (CR1 by NTA, Bonferroni over 60 tests). This form of the test was not set before the run.
